Definition: from a compound of G4862 and G1586; chosen in company with, i.e. co-elect (fellow Christian):--elected together with.
BiblicalUsage: Peter sends greetings from the church at Babylon, elected together with the churches he writes to, and Marcus his son greets them too. Election is shared: one church is chosen together with another, and the greeting crosses the distance because the choosing did.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that election is something God's people share, and I hold that being chosen together is the bond between churches that have never met.
